title: Level 3 — worn birthday-party redesign
mode: built-in image_gen; generation guided by actual current Studio screenshots
scope: Six concept images only. No Blender geometry, Studio game content, or published experience changed.
artDirection: Semi-dirty inexpensive 1990s mall children's-party Backrooms. Low yellowed ceiling tiles, flat fluorescent lights, cheap laminate folding tables, mismatched molded plastic chairs, worn patterned carpets, plain beige/orange/red walls and modest party decorations. Improve composition, branching sightlines, material detail and functional side rooms while retaining the existing venue identity.

baseline.studioRead: Current Level 3 Configuration, Layout Generator and World Builder Source/editor pairs were read and matched the prior Studio audit at task start.

limitations: Concept art is more detailed than current Roblox rendering; these are not current-game screenshots.
No mesh, collision, modular connection, gameplay or performance validation is implied by these images.
Wear is slightly stronger in the orange carpet and service-room furniture than in the baseline screenshots.
